title: I Didn't Kneel When the Bell Rang. (Part 1)
summary: Fold stands up for Grandma and makes the king hear the bell that forced his town to kneel.
frame_0: Fold stands in the center of the kneeling crowd. The king points from the belfry beside a swinging gold bell under the title.
